name: Integrations
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize, then select Theme Settings and Integrations.
Forms use native Shopify submission and spam protection. Location cards provide search, contact links and directions without an external map API.
Leave unused social URLs empty. A social link does not embed a feed or connect an account.
Do not paste private keys into theme settings. Configure installed apps through their own settings.
Set shared defaults here. A section with its own override may retain that override; select the section to adjust it.
Preview a home, product, collection, and cart page before saving shared changes.

settings.label: Allow legacy custom code
settings.info: Controls the three code fields below. Existing code stays enabled for compatibility. These fields run trusted HTML/JavaScript without consent handling. Prefer app embeds; configure tracking through Shopify pixels.
settings.how: Turn on “Allow legacy custom code” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Legacy custom code: head
settings.info: Advanced: trusted code only. Runs on storefront pages, including Theme Editor previews. Never paste secrets. This is not a pixel or consent manager. Blank or none outputs nothing.
settings.how: Advanced legacy integration slot. Prefer an app embed or native section. Only add code you own or trust; never enter credentials. Leave the default none when unused. The Allow legacy custom code switch controls these slots.

settings.label: Form consent metadata
settings.info: Sends metadata to configured form handlers only. Does not add a checkbox, opt a customer in, or change Shopify tracking consent. Newsletter confirmation remains explicit.
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for form consent metadata. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Default hidden tags
settings.info: Base tags for supported forms; section tags are appended. Tags do not subscribe customers or configure an external app.
settings.how: Enter the default hidden tags. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Facebook page URL
settings.info: Profile destination, not a live feed or tracking integration. Use an HTTP(S) URL. Explicit block links take priority; unsafe destinations are ignored.
settings.how: Enter the facebook page url. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.
